Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

DietView 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN release.

Beyond stomach contents

  • dv_prepare(taxonomy = "gbif") and the new dv_taxonomy_gbif() resolve prey against the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (all kingdoms), for terrestrial and freshwater diets. Same rules as WoRMS: key, exact name, then fuzzy name, a per-prey provenance log, an on-disk cache and dv_taxonomy_report(). GBIF adds two review flags: "higherrank" matches and low_confidence. No new dependency.
  • dv_parse_lineage() splits lineage strings from metabarcoding pipelines (QIIME 2, DADA2, SILVA, MIDORI, BOLD, BLAST) into rank columns, so the reference taxonomy used for assignment (NCBI, SILVA, BOLD…) can be kept with taxonomy = "columns".
  • dv_from_wide() reshapes wide sample-by-taxon tables (ASV/OTU tables, catch compositions) into the long format and joins sample metadata.
  • dv_spec(weight_type = ): "mass" (default), "reads" (pooled read share) or "rra" (relative read abundance, the mean over samples of per-sample read proportions). Labels of the weight views follow.
  • dv_resolution(): the finest rank each record reaches, by any grouping, without needing a digestion column (the identification-resolution diagnostic for DNA data); dv_digestion_diagnostic() now builds on it, and the Shiny app shows a “Resolution” tab when there is no digestion column.
  • dv_spec(unit_label = ): names the sampling unit (“scat”, “sample”, “haul”…) in messages, printouts, the dashboard and the Shiny app. Argument and column names are unchanged.
  • New example data: salish_seal_dna and salish_seal_lineage, the DNA metabarcoding diet of 4,625 Salish Sea harbour seal scats (Thomas et al. 2022, CC0).
  • dv_cache_clear() gains source = c("all", "worms", "gbif").
  • New article: “Beyond stomachs: DNA metabarcoding, scats and other compositional data”.
